_comment: Release automation config. minimumSupportedVersionCode: if omitted or 0, defaults to the new versionCode (fully mandatory). Set it LOWER than the new versionCode to allow older versions to keep working. releaseNotes: bullets shown on the update screen. You only edit THIS file and the versionCode/versionName in app/build.gradle.kts — the workflow generates version.json and the GitHub Release automatically.
releaseNotes: 16 new multi-panel Gallery transitions (Motion, Wall, 3D Scroll, Align, Social, Frame, Cam, Space, Preview, Grid, Messy, Morph, Carousel, Columns) + Social & Photo categories
Layers system: image/text/logo overlays above the transition, corner presets, position/size/rotation/opacity/timing — baked into the export
4-lane timeline: ruler, clips (drag right edge to resize 0.5s-60s), live audio waveform, overlay lanes; zoom 0.5x-4x; auto-scroll follows the playhead
Split clip or audio at the playhead with one tap
Export stability: muxer EOS state machine fixes the 100% -> failed bug
